article-marker-v1.precondition: The contextual gloss is missing or rejected as a placeholder; source class is det, source lemma is exactly ὁ, and source morphology begins T-.
article-marker-v1.reason: Greek definite articles often remain untranslated in English, especially before proper names. The grammar marker explains the actual source word without claiming an extra word belongs in an English sentence.
article-marker-v1.restriction: This rule is only for verified article morphology. Other word classes require a verified occurrence-specific source gloss or are marked unavailable.
